The question: "We're deciding today whether to downgrade and I need a firm answer — will we lose that data permanently or can we get it back later?" This is about downgrading plan and data retention. According to DOC-031 parts: downgrading does not delete anything; data is hidden, preserved, becomes visible again if upgrade. Exception: data subject to retention window: lower tier with shorter retention period will age out older records over time, not delete at moment of downgrade. So answer: you won't lose data permanently; it's retained, but may be subject to retention windows. Provide firm answer. Use short answer. No need to escalate. Use post_reply.

arguments.message: Downgrading won’t permanently delete your data. Anything tied to a higher‑tier feature is simply hidden and will reappear if you upgrade again. The only exception is data that falls outside the lower tier’s retention window—those records will age out over time, just as they would on a workspace that started on that tier. So you won’t lose data immediately, and you can recover it later by upgrading, provided it’s still within the applicable retention period.
